payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates all quadruples (i, j, k, l) to check if points a[i], a[j], b[k], b[l] are collinear; prints No if found, else Yes.
payload.rationale: The code performs an exhaustive search over index sets, albeit with a flawed condition. No greedy or sorting strategies are used, so it belongs to complete_search family, and 'search_branch_and_bound' is the closest available subtype.
